chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn Abī Ḥamzah, and Ḥusayn ibn Hāshim, and Ibn Ribāṭ, and Ṣafwān ibn Yaḥyā, all of them from Yaʿqūb ibn Shuʿayb, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about the time of ẓuhr, and he said: when the shadow is one cubit.

key_terms.الْفَيْءِ: the returning shadow used to determine prayer time
key_terms.ذِرَاعًا: one cubit, a unit of measure for the shadow
key_terms.وَقْتِ: the appointed time or prescribed time

ai.seo_question: When does the time of ẓuhr prayer begin according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the beginning time of ẓuhr prayer. It states that the time is identified by the shadow reaching one cubit, making it relevant to prayer-time determination in fiqh.
